documents.title: UK ADVANCE 2025 Guidelines and Recommendations for Generative AI in Instructional Contexts
documents.stance_why: The document says instructors 'will adopt a range of policies and approaches' and that policies 'likely will fall within one of four areas on a spectrum' (no use, use only when/as directed, use freely in certain cases, use freely in all cases). It sets no default rule itself and hands the decision to instructors, so the stance is delegates with those four tiers.
documents.summary: UK ADVANCE's 2025 guidelines do not set a university-wide AI rule for coursework. They explain AI's capabilities and risks, tell instructors how to write and communicate a course policy along a four-point spectrum, advise against AI detectors, and suggest assignment designs and instructor uses of AI.
